title: 2026 FX information, personal FX (08): how a foreign individual buys FX with pay earned in China
quote: 境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇
means: A foreign individual's lawful current-account RMB income earned in China is converted at a bank on a valid ID plus source-of-funds papers that show the amount, including tax vouchers (citing Hui Fa [2020] No. 14, Art. 59).

title: 2024 current-account FX Q&A case (9): do foreign individuals get the annual facilitation quota?
quote: 持有外国人永久居留身份证的境外个人适用购汇年度便利化额度。
means: Among foreign individuals, only holders of a Foreign Permanent Resident ID card use the annual facilitation quota; others convert documented lawful income.

title: 2026 FX information, personal FX (10): converting unused RMB back to foreign currency
quote: 凭本人有效身份证件和原兑换水单办理，原兑换水单的兑回有效期为自兑换日起24个月；对于当日累计兑换不超过等值500美元（含）以及离境前在境内关外场所当日累计不超过等值1000美元（含）的兑换，可凭本人有效身份证件办理。
means: Unused RMB that was originally converted from foreign currency can be converted back on ID plus the original exchange memo (valid 24 months); up to USD 500 a day (USD 1,000 airside before departure) on ID alone.

title: Circular on Regulating Large-sum Overseas Cash Withdrawals with Bank Cards
quote: the sum of withdrawals using the bank cards under the name of the individual (including supplementary cards) shall not exceed the equivalent of RMB 100,000 in every civil year … the equivalent of RMB 10,000 per card per day
means: Overseas ATM cash on mainland cards: RMB 100,000 per person per calendar year across all cards, RMB 10,000 per card per day; exceeding the yearly cap bars overseas withdrawals for that year and the next; borrowing or lending cards to get round it is prohibited.

issuer: SAFE and General Administration of Customs (State Council Gazette)
title: Hui Fa [2003] No. 102: Interim Measures on Carrying Foreign Currency Cash Across the Border
quote: 出境人员携出金额在等值5000美元以内(含5000美元)的，不需申领《携带证》… 在等值5000美元以上至10000美元(含10000美元)的，应当向银行申领《携带证》… 在等值10000美元以上的，应当向存款或购汇银行所在地国家外汇管理局各分支局申领《携带证》
means: Leaving China with foreign cash: up to USD 5,000 no permit; over USD 5,000 up to USD 10,000 needs a bank-issued carrying permit (valid 30 days, single use); above USD 10,000 needs a SAFE-issued permit, in principle not allowed. A second exit within 15 days is limited to USD 1,000.

title: Regulations of the PRC on Foreign Exchange Administration (State Council Decree No. 532)
quote: 第五条 国家对经常性国际支付和转移不予限制。… 第三十九条 … 处逃汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处逃汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款 … 第五十二条（二）境内个人，是指中国公民和在中华人民共和国境内连续居住满1年的外国人
means: Current international payments are not restricted (Art. 5) but must rest on a real, lawful transaction that the bank reviews (Art. 12). Fines: evasion (Art. 39), fraudulent FX purchase (Art. 40) and private FX trading (Art. 45) up to 30% of the amount, 30%–100% if serious; unlawful carrying of FX up to 20% (Art. 42). 'Domestic individual' includes foreigners who have lived in China continuously for one year (Art. 52).

issuer: SAFE (Tianjin branch copy of the amended text)
title: Detailed Rules for the Measures on Individual Foreign Exchange (Hui Fa [2007] No. 1, as amended)
quote: 第二条 对个人结汇和境内个人购汇实行年度总额管理。年度总额分别为每人每年等值5万美元。… 第四条 … 超过年度总额的购汇、结汇以及境外个人购汇，可以按本细则规定，凭相关证明材料委托他人办理。
means: Annual total for FX purchases by domestic individuals: USD 50,000 per person per year. Above that, current-account purchases need ID plus documents showing the amount (Art. 12). Purchases by foreign individuals and above-quota purchases can be delegated to another person with the supporting documents (Art. 4).

title: Notice on Further Improving Individual Foreign Exchange Administration (watch list)
quote: 不得以分拆等方式规避额度及真实性管理 … “关注名单”内个人的关注期限为列入“关注名单”的当年及之后连续2年
means: Individuals may not split transactions to get round the quota or the genuineness check. People who do, or who lend their quota, go on a watch list for that year and the next two; during that time every conversion needs ID plus documents at the counter.

issuer: SAFE (site search listing of Hui Fa [2009] No. 56)
title: Notice on Further Improving the Administration of Individual FX Settlement and Sale (splitting features)
quote: （二）5个以上不同个人同日、隔日或连续多日分别购汇后，将外汇汇给境外同一个人或机构。
means: Listed features of splitting include five or more different people buying FX on the same, alternate or consecutive days and remitting it to the same overseas person, and one person receiving quota-sized transfers from five or more relatives.

title: Announcement 2013 No. 40: tax recordal for outbound payments under service trade and other items
quote: 境内机构和个人向境外单笔支付等值5万美元以上（不含等值5万美元，下同）下列外汇资金，除本公告第三条规定的情形外，均应向所在地主管税务机关进行税务备案
means: A single outbound payment above USD 50,000 in the listed categories needs a tax recordal form filed with the local tax office before the bank pays. This is a filing, not a tax.

issuer: People's Bank of China (State Council Gazette)
title: PBOC Announcement [2004] No. 16: Interim Measures on the Sale and Payment of FX for Transfers of Personal Property Abroad
quote: 首次可汇出金额不得超过全部申请转移财产的一半；自首次汇出满1年后，可汇出不超过剩余财产的一半；自首次汇出满2年后，可汇出全部剩余财产。全部申请转移财产在等值人民币20万元以下（含20万元）的，经批准后可一次性汇出。
means: Emigrant transfers (assets owned before emigrating) and inheritance transfers (a foreign citizen inheriting a mainland estate) go through SAFE. Emigrants apply once for the full amount and remit in stages: up to half first, up to half of the rest after one year, the remainder after two years; RMB 200,000 or less can go at once.

title: PBOC issues the Interim Measures on transfers of personal property abroad
quote: 从同一被继承人继承的全部财产，只须一次性申请，可一次或分次汇出。
means: Inherited property from one decedent needs one application and can be remitted in one or several payments.

title: FX business and policy Q&A (49): foreign individual selling a mainland home and remitting through an agent
quote: 境外个人出售境内商品房委托他人购汇的，需提供经公证的授权委托书等材料。
means: A foreign individual who sells a mainland home can have someone else buy the FX, with a notarised power of attorney among the documents (citing the 2017 capital-account operating guide, item 6.26).

title: Individual Income Tax Law of the People's Republic of China
quote: For comprehensive income … progressive tax rates ranging from 3 percent to 45 percent shall apply … For income from interest, dividends or bonuses, income from leasing of assets, income from transfer of assets, and incidental income, a flat tax rate of 20 percent shall apply.
means: PRC individual income tax is charged on the income itself: 3%–45% on comprehensive income (wages and similar), 5%–35% on business income, 20% on interest, dividends, rent, asset transfers and incidental income.

issuer: Ministry of Finance and State Taxation Administration
title: Cai Shui [2008] No. 132: individual income tax on savings deposit interest
quote: 自2008年10月9日起，对储蓄存款利息所得暂免征收个人所得税。
means: Interest on savings deposits has been temporarily exempt from PRC individual income tax since 9 October 2008.

issuer: People's Bank of China and seven other agencies
title: Yin Fa [2026] No. 42: notice on further preventing and handling risks of virtual currencies
quote: 虚拟货币相关业务活动属于非法金融活动。在境内开展法定货币与虚拟货币兑换业务 … 一律严格禁止，坚决依法取缔。
means: Virtual-currency business activity, including exchanging legal tender for virtual currency in China, is illegal financial activity and strictly prohibited.

title: BOC Exchange Rate board, USD row
quote: USD | Buying Rate 666.3 | Cash Buying Rate 666.3 | Selling Rate 669.11 | Cash Selling Rate 669.11 | Middle Rate 671.91 | Pub Time 2026/11/11 10:25:02
means: Per USD 100. A customer buying dollars pays the selling rate: RMB 6.6911 per dollar at that minute. The bank buys dollars at RMB 6.6630.

title: BOC e-banking personal transfer and remittance fee table
quote: 跨境汇款（电汇） 每笔汇款金额的1‰，最低收取50元/笔，最高收取260元/笔；另收电讯费,港澳台地区人民币80元/笔,非港澳台地区人民币150元/笔。
means: Cross-border telegraphic transfer: 0.1% of the amount, minimum RMB 50 and maximum RMB 260 per transfer, plus a cable fee of RMB 150 (RMB 80 to Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan). Local or agreed prices may differ.

title: Tariff of Accounts and Services for Wealth and Personal Banking Business
quote: 0.1% of remittance amount Min. CNY100 / equivalent per transaction Max. CNY500 / equivalent per transaction Plus Cable Charge … CNY120 / equivalent
means: The tariff's outward-remittance rows show 0.1% (minimum CNY 100, maximum CNY 500) plus a cable charge, and a CNY 120 cable figure. The extract returned today is a flattened table, so which customer tier pays which figure was not re-confirmed.

title: Help Centre: Guide to CNY transfers (Sending from CNY)
quote: You can send money from CNY if: You're not mainland Chinese … You're working or have worked in China before … You have a valid tax record issued by the China tax authority showing taxes paid within the last 3 years … the maximum you can send in one transfer is 300,000 CNY
means: Wise sends CNY out of China only for non-mainland people who work or worked in China and hold a tax record from the last three years, only to an account they own, at most CNY 300,000 per transfer, within an overall limit of roughly after-tax China salary.

issuer: U.S. House, Office of the Law Revision Counsel
title: 26 U.S.C. 988(e): application to individuals, personal transactions
quote: no gain shall be recognized for purposes of this subtitle by reason of changes in exchange rates after such currency was acquired by such individual and before such disposition. The preceding sentence shall not apply if the gain which would otherwise be recognized on the transaction exceeds $200.
means: When an individual disposes of foreign currency in a personal transaction, exchange gain of USD 200 or less is not recognised; a larger gain is.

title: Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR)
quote: the aggregate value of those foreign financial accounts exceeded $10,000 at any time during the calendar year reported … due April 15 following the calendar year reported. You’re allowed an automatic extension to October 15
means: A U.S. person files an FBAR when foreign accounts together exceeded USD 10,000 at any time in the year; due 15 April with an automatic extension to 15 October.

title: 31 CFR 1010.821: penalty adjustment and table
quote: 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(B)(i) Foreign Financial Agency Transaction—Non-Willful Violation of Transaction 10,000 16,536 … 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(C)(i)(I) … Willful Violation of Transaction 100,000 165,353
means: Maximum FBAR civil penalties for penalties assessed on or after 17 January 2025: USD 16,536 non-wilful; USD 165,353 for the wilful dollar figure.

title: Summary of FATCA reporting for U.S. taxpayers (Form 8938)
quote: more than $200,000 of specified foreign financial assets at the end of the year and you live abroad; or more than $50,000, if you live in the United States … a $10,000 failure to file penalty, an additional penalty of up to $50,000 … and a 40 percent penalty on an understatement of tax attributable to non-disclosed assets
means: Form 8938 thresholds for a single filer: more than USD 50,000 at year end (or USD 75,000 at any time) living in the U.S.; more than USD 200,000 at year end living abroad; doubled for joint filers. Penalty USD 10,000, up to USD 50,000 more after notice, plus 40% on related understatements.

title: Gifts from foreign person (Form 3520, Part IV)
quote: you are required to report the receipt of such gifts or bequests only if the aggregate amount received from that nonresident alien or foreign estate … exceeds $100,000 during the taxable year
means: A gift or bequest from a nonresident alien or foreign estate is excluded from the recipient's gross income but must be reported on Form 3520 when the total from that person and related persons exceeds USD 100,000 in the year; late or incomplete filing can bring penalties under IRC 6039F(c).

title: Money and Other Monetary Instruments (FinCEN Form 105)
quote: when entering or leaving the United States you must report amounts exceeding $10,000 … When families or groups are involved, the $10,000 threshold applies to the total amount they are carrying or sending collectively, not per individual.
means: Carrying more than USD 10,000 in currency or monetary instruments into the U.S. must be reported on FinCEN Form 105; a family travelling together counts as one total. Unreported money can be seized.

title: Figuring the foreign earned income exclusion
quote: For tax year 2025, the maximum foreign earned income exclusion is the lesser of the foreign income earned or $130,000 per qualifying person. For tax year 2026, the maximum exclusion is $132,900 per person.
means: Foreign earned income exclusion: up to USD 130,000 for 2025 and USD 132,900 for 2026, for people who meet the bona fide residence or physical presence test. It covers earned income only.

title: Publication 54, Tax Guide for U.S. Citizens and Resident Aliens Abroad
quote: If you are a U.S. citizen or resident alien, your worldwide income is generally subject to U.S. income tax, regardless of where you are living. … If you paid taxes to a foreign government on income from sources outside the United States, you may be able to claim a foreign tax credit … Form 1116 is used to figure the allowable credit.
means: A U.S. citizen is taxed on worldwide income in the year it is earned, wherever they live. Income tax paid to China on that income can be credited against U.S. tax using Form 1116.

title: Yearly average currency exchange rates
quote: The Internal Revenue Service has no official exchange rate. Generally, it accepts any posted exchange rate that is used consistently. … China | Yuan | 7.129 | 7.189 | 7.075 | 6.730 | 6.452 (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021) … A taxpayer may also need to recognize foreign currency gain or loss on certain foreign currency transactions. See section 988
means: IRS yearly average yuan per dollar: 7.129 (2025), 7.189 (2024), 7.075 (2023), 6.730 (2022), 6.452 (2021). The IRS has no official rate and accepts any posted rate used consistently; it points to section 988 for currency gain or loss.

title: United States – People's Republic of China Income Tax Convention
quote: if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the dividends the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the dividends
means: Tax charged by the source country on dividends (Art. 9) and interest (Art. 10) paid to a beneficial owner resident in the other country is capped at 10% of the gross amount.

title: IRM 20.1.9 International Penalties: other offshore compliance procedures
quote: The Streamlined Domestic Offshore Procedures provide U.S. taxpayers who filed income tax returns and who reside in the United States the opportunity to certify that their conduct was non-willful and pay a 5 percent miscellaneous offshore penalty.
means: People living in the U.S. who missed foreign-account filings non-wilfully can come forward under the Streamlined Domestic Offshore Procedures and pay a 5% miscellaneous offshore penalty.
